Variants.Content: Oium grain, herds, woodland and river exchange sustain households. Distant goods require vessels and intermediaries rather than being freely available chiefly wealth.

Oium food, herds, woodland and river exchange sustain households. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Distant goods need vessels, escorts and intermediaries.

Distant goods need vessels, escorts and intermediaries. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Oium food, herds, woodland and river exchange sustain households.
